notes.title: Arena Mode Released
notes.content:
Hello, gamers,

I am happy to tell you that Fantasy Dungeon VR is receiving a major update today, including one new mode, hundreds of fixes, tweaks, balance changes, and optimized game size.

Arena Mode
Arena Mode is available now with a focus on combat. Excluding exploring dungeon rooms from Dungeon Mode, Arena Mode features more intense combat and random shop purchases.

Switch between Arena Mode and Dungeon Mode with the left-hand game menu. (Left trigger + left menu button)
